note: Webform Content Creator defines the config entity type webform_content_creator (class Entity\WebformContentCreatorEntity), config prefix webform_content_creator.webform_content_creator.<id>. Key fields: webform (source webform id), target_entity_type (default node), target_bundle, elements (per-field mapping map keyed by target field + a special 'title' entry, each {type, webform_field, custom_check, custom_value, mapping}), plus sync_content (edit sync), sync_content_delete, sync_unique, sync_content_field, use_encrypt/encryption_profile, redirect_to_entity(+messages). Admin UI at admin/config/webform_content_creator (route webform_content_creator.collection); Manage fields at admin/config/webform_content_creator/manage/{id}/fields; permission 'access webform content creator configuration'. Driven by hook_webform_submission_insert/update/delete -> entity createContent()/updateContent(). Field values applied via @WebformContentCreatorFieldMapping plugins (manager plugin.manager.webform_content_creator.field_mapping, default_mapping + type-specific). Medium/hard cases are grounded in the local config entities: setup/reset write known mappings, verify/introspection read them back (no webform submission is actually run).

evals.prompt: How do I make Drupal create a node automatically every time a particular webform is submitted, using the webform_content_creator module? What config does it use?
evals.expected_output: Create a Webform Content Creator config entity (admin/config/webform_content_creator > Add configuration) binding the webform to a target entity type/bundle (e.g. node/article), then use Manage fields to map webform values to content fields and set the title. On each non-draft submission the webform submission hooks call the entity's createContent() to build and save the content.

evals.prompt: In a webform_content_creator configuration, where is the field mapping stored and what does each mapping entry contain? How do I set the created content's title from a webform value?
evals.expected_output: The mapping is stored in the config entity's 'elements' map, keyed by target field machine name plus a special 'title' entry. Each entry has type, webform_field (source element key), custom_check (use custom_value token instead), custom_value (a token string), and mapping (the field mapping plugin id). Set the title via the 'title' entry's custom_value, e.g. [webform_submission:values:subject], on the Manage fields form.

evals.prompt: webform_content_creator uses pluggable field mappings. What is the plugin type / annotation and the default mapping plugin, and how would I add support for a custom field type?
evals.expected_output: Field mappings are @WebformContentCreatorFieldMapping plugins (manager plugin.manager.webform_content_creator.field_mapping, base FieldMappingBase, interface FieldMappingInterface) in src/Plugin/WebformContentCreator/FieldMapping. The default is default_mapping (field_types empty = any). Add one by creating a plugin class with an id, label, weight, and field_types, implementing mapEntityField().

evals.prompt: This site has a Webform Content Creator configuration. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which webform it listens to and what content (entity type and bundle) it creates.
evals.expected_output: The wcc_known configuration listens to the 'contact' webform and creates node/article content: webform_content_creator.webform_content_creator.wcc_known has webform=contact, target_entity_type=node, target_bundle=article.

evals.prompt: For that Webform Content Creator configuration, inspect the live config: when someone edits an existing webform submission, is the previously created content updated to match?
evals.expected_output: Yes — edit synchronization is enabled: wcc_known has sync_content = true, so editing a submission updates the previously created content (via updateContent()).

evals.prompt: Using webform_content_creator, set this site up so that submissions of the 'contact' webform create Article nodes. Create a Webform Content Creator configuration that maps the 'contact' webform to the node entity type and the 'article' bundle, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A webform_content_creator config entity exists with webform = 'contact', target_entity_type = 'node', target_bundle = 'article' (created via the entity storage/API or the admin form at admin/config/webform_content_creator/add).

evals.prompt: There is an existing Webform Content Creator configuration named 'wcc_edit'. Right now, editing a submission does not update the content it created. Change the configuration so that editing a submission also updates the created content, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The webform_content_creator.webform_content_creator.wcc_edit config entity has sync_content = true (edit synchronization enabled).
